strips.title: The Trillion-Dollar Tuesday
strips.headline: Remember When Bosses Were Forcing Their Workers to Use AI? They're Now Realizing They Made a Huge Mistake

panels.speaker: Pinocchio
panels.line: This AI company is worth a trillion dollars!

panels.speaker: Pinocchio
panels.line: And I invented their product last Tuesday.

panels.speaker: Gandalf
panels.line: You shall not pass that valuation without revenue.

panels.speaker: Pinocchio
panels.line: AI will do every job by Friday!

strips.title: The Bug Slayer
strips.headline: AI Is Finding Software Flaws Faster Than The World Can Fix Them

panels.speaker: Pinocchio
panels.line: This AI makes every system unhackable!

strips.title: There Is No Opting Out
strips.headline: Google says there’s no way to use Search without using artificial intelligence

panels.speaker: Pinocchio
panels.line: Every search is AI now. You can’t even opt out!

panels.speaker: Pinocchio
panels.line: It also answered your question before you asked it. Twice.

panels.speaker: Gandalf
panels.line: You shall not pass that answer without a source link.
